name: item_list
title: List test items
description: List the test items of the open binary, sorted by address, name or size. Use filter.name and filter.size_min to narrow the list. The tool exists only in the test registry.

count.description: The number of test items in the binary.

name.description: Keep the items whose name holds this text.

size_min.description: Keep the items with at least this size.

sort.description: The sort order of the items.

binary_id.description: The ID of the target binary. Leave it out when exactly one binary is open.

format.description: The detail level. The detailed form adds provenance, coercion details and sizes.

fields.description: JSON pointers into data. The result keeps only these fields.

max_chars.description: The largest result in characters. The count includes every copy of the result.

limit.description: The largest number of items on one page.

cursor.description: The page.next_cursor of the previous page.

count_only.description: Return only the count of the items.

shape.description: The form of the items. The table form gives cols and rows.

in.description: Keep only the members of this named set, for example set:parsers.

session.description: The session label for provenance, filters and the undo scope.

name: item_get
title: Get test items
description: Get one or more test items by address with the selected sections. Send target for one item or targets for up to 50 items.

targets.description: The addresses of up to 50 items.

binary_id.description: The ID of the target binary. Leave it out when exactly one binary is open.

format.description: The detail level. The detailed form adds provenance, coercion details and sizes.

fields.description: JSON pointers into data. The result keeps only these fields.

max_chars.description: The largest result in characters. The count includes every copy of the result.

session.description: The session label for provenance, filters and the undo scope.

name: item_edit
title: Edit test items
description: Edit the test items: create, rename or delete one item. Each action has its own required arguments. The delete action is destructive.

name.description: The new name of the item.

binary_id.description: The ID of the target binary. Leave it out when exactly one binary is open.

format.description: The detail level. The detailed form adds provenance, coercion details and sizes.

fields.description: JSON pointers into data. The result keeps only these fields.

max_chars.description: The largest result in characters. The count includes every copy of the result.

session.description: The session label for provenance, filters and the undo scope.

expected_rev.description: The rev that the call expects. Another rev gives CONFLICT.

dry_run.description: Return the planned edit list with no commit.

force.description: Allow an agent write over an imported fact. The journal records the force.

name: echo_value
title: Echo a value
description: Echo a JSON value with an optional flag and tag. The tool needs no binary.

flag.description: A flag that the tool gives back.

tag.description: A note ID or a set ID.

format.description: The detail level. The detailed form adds provenance, coercion details and sizes.

fields.description: JSON pointers into data. The result keeps only these fields.

max_chars.description: The largest result in characters. The count includes every copy of the result.

session.description: The session label for provenance, filters and the undo scope.

name: fuel_run
title: Run a fuel test
description: Run a fuel test: use a number of work units from the fuel of the call. The tool sends a progress report for each 100 units.

work.description: The number of fuel units to use.

binary_id.description: The ID of the target binary. Leave it out when exactly one binary is open.

format.description: The detail level. The detailed form adds provenance, coercion details and sizes.

fields.description: JSON pointers into data. The result keeps only these fields.

max_chars.description: The largest result in characters. The count includes every copy of the result.

session.description: The session label for provenance, filters and the undo scope.

max_steps.description: The fuel of the call in work units.

max_ms.description: A wall-clock guard in milliseconds. Fuel stays the main stop rule.
